107: pub open spec fn size_of_bin(bin_idx: int) -> nat
108:     recommends valid_bin_idx(bin_idx)
109: {
110:     if 1 <= bin_idx <= 8 {
111:        (usize::BITS / 8) as nat * (bin_idx as nat)
112:     } else if bin_idx == BIN_HUGE {
113:         8 * (524288 + 1)
114:     } else {
115:         let group = (bin_idx - 9) / 4;
116:         let inner = (bin_idx - 9) % 4;
117:         ((usize::BITS / 8) * (inner + 5) * pow2((group + 1) as nat)) as nat
118:     }
119: }

121: pub open spec fn smallest_bin_fitting_size(size: int) -> int {
122:     let bytes_per_word = (usize::BITS / 8) as int;
123:     let wsize = (size + bytes_per_word - 1) / bytes_per_word;
124:     if wsize <= 1 { 1 }
125:     else if wsize <= 8 { wsize }
126:     else if wsize > 524288 { BIN_HUGE as int }
127:     else {
128:         let w = (wsize - 1) as u64;
129:         let lz = u64_leading_zeros(w);
130:         let b = (usize::BITS - 1 - lz) as u8;
131:         let shifted = (w >> (b - 2) as u64) as u8;
132:         ((b * 4) + (shifted & 0x03)) - 3
133:     }
134: }
